name_reason: Follows the convention fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=chapter, descriptor=transition_with_intro). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects the function: orchestrates an inter-chapter transition that runs the chapter-intro pose zoom-in animation and the per-state intro menu. Sole caller fd2_chapter_transition_menu confirms the chapter-transition role.
purpose: Chapter-intro orchestrator: optional story dialog scene, then a 10-frame pose zoom-in animation, then dispatch to the per-state chapter-intro menu (type B/C/main); returns whether the user committed the chapter advance.
logic_summary: result_code=0. Reads the chapter-intro metadata entry for the current chapter (data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id) and keeps metadata[0] as the category byte. Stops BGM via fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade(-1,0). Branches on data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state: if state==2 (story-dialog branch) it loads portrait 0x4B, shows the dialog scene, marks data_fd2_battle_tile_map_ptr=1 during the typewriter loop then back to 0, tears the dialog down; a typewriter result of -1 or data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx!=0 cancels (return 0); past a late-chapter/game-clear party-size threshold (<0x1B && >0x10, or >=0x1B && >0x14) it splices the menu roster into the runtime char ptr and runs fd2_run_recruitment_or_branch_screen (a 0 result cancels, nulls the splice, returns 0); on success result_code=1. Then the common pose zoom-in: splices runtime_char_array_ptr=menu roster, malloc's a 64000-byte VGA backup, and for i in 1..10 blits the scaled pose (table index = cursor_state + category_byte*6) toward its per-chapter target with shrinking scale (0x80 - i*9), commits the per-frame composite from data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr to VGA, and ramps palette brightness (i*4); settles palette at 0x40 and clears VGA. Post-anim menu dispatch on cursor_state selects a BGM track and an intro menu: state 0 -> BGM 0xD + typeB, state 4 -> BGM 0xB + typeC, state 2 -> skip (result already set), state 3 -> BGM 0xF + main, others -> BGM 0xE + main; then BGM track 10 (post-intro ambient). Cleanup frees the pose backup, nulls data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr, returns result_code.

returns.semantics: 1 if the user committed the chapter advance, 0 if cancelled (story-dialog cancel via typewriter==-1 / cursor!=0, recruitment-screen cancel, or state-2 path that produced result_code via the dialog branch).

writes_globals: data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (0x53A45) -- spliced to menu roster during transition, nulled on cleanup/cancel
data_fd2_battle_tile_map_ptr (0x53A51) -- set to 1 during story dialog, back to 0 after
